headline: Century Casinos receives Nasdaq deficiency notice over market value requirement
summary: Century Casinos announced it received a deficiency notice from Nasdaq regarding its failure to satisfy the exchange's minimum market value requirement.
why: Nasdaq listing deficiencies can trigger delisting proceedings or capital restructurings if minimum market value standards are not regained.

impacts.name: Century Casinos Inc
impacts.why: Deficiency notices create compliance deadlines and risk delisting from major public stock exchanges.
